broadOverlap.note: Copies in functions shared with broad cannot be separated by aggregate PC counters. Do not add the full immutable-read estimate to broad savings.

exclusions: any scalar slot with a compiler-created local address
assumptions: Function parameters and let/const slots remain owned, not aliases of initializer temporaries.
No declaration/argument/return copy elimination is counted.
Original compiler rejects recursion; ancestor and descendant packed frames cannot overlap.
Any future direct-read lowering must preserve all calls, guards, numeric operations, mutable value snapshots and source caps.
A new bytecode layout requires fresh buffers or matching-layout checkpoints; no old VM checkpoint conversion.
scope: Two-h prestrike measured core copy count only; not GPU timing, source-native admission, contact/full-rest parity or 1024-row throughput.
